parameters.content:
## 09-10-01 capture photo proof of delivery with AI

### How it works

Drivers fill a simple form with the waybill, recipient name, notes and a photo of the delivered package. The workflow looks the waybill up in the deliveries register, checks the photo with AI vision, logs every submission to a proof log, emails the customer when the proof is verified, and alerts the ops team on Telegram and email for exceptions.

Exception alerts fire when a waybill is not in the register, when a submission has no photo, and when the AI cannot confirm the photo as usable proof. A daily sweep builds a list of deliveries still missing photo proof after 2 days, and AI writes a short nudge to follow up.

### Setup steps

- Create the Google Sheets workbook with two tabs: Deliveries (waybill, customer_name, customer_email, address, driver, driver_email, status, assigned_date, delivered_at, notes) and PodLog (log_id, waybill, status, signal, recipient, notes, photo_flag, detail, created_at).
- Add pending deliveries with status In Transit and the assigned date.
- Connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram and OpenAI credentials.
- Set the email addresses in the alert nodes (customer emails come from the register).
- Set the Telegram chat id for the ops alerts.

### Customization

- Change the overdue threshold in the daily sweep code node.
- Swap the vision model to a stronger one if your photos are hard to read.
- Route the weekly summary to any inbox that owns follow up.

## Delivery proof intake

Drivers submit waybill, recipient and photo. Missing waybills and unknown waybills are rejected with alerts.

## AI photo verification

GPT-4o-mini vision checks the photo and returns ok or mismatch. Only verified photos mark the delivery as Delivered.

parameters.content:
## Verified, exception and alert lanes

Verified proofs log, email the customer and confirm on Telegram. Exceptions (no photo, unusable photo, unknown waybill) alert ops on Telegram and email.

## Daily pending sweep

Every morning, deliveries older than 2 days without photo proof get an AI-written nudge and alerts.

## Weekly summary

Every Monday, AI writes a summary of the proof log: total entries, exceptions and unrecognized waybills.
